findings.suggested_fix: Consider a target-language title that preserves the original sense (a man who gives out mints, not a vendor). Suggested alternatives: "Pria Pembagi Permen Mint" or "Pria Pembagi Mint". If the translator prefers a shorter form, "Si Pembagi Permen Mint" keeps the emphasis on his giving rather than selling.

findings.source_quote: a swarm of young boys and girls began to cluster around Brother Silas like chickadees at a birdfeeder.
findings.suggested_fix: The translated simile uses "burung-ciung," a literal borrowing that may be unfamiliar to many Indonesian readers. Consider replacing with a more familiar idiom while preserving the image of small birds crowding at a feeder. Suggested alternatives: "seperti kawanan burung kecil di tempat makan burung" or "seperti burung-burung kecil yang berkerumun di tempat makan burung."
findings.translation_quote: kawanan anak laki-laki dan perempuan mulai mengerumuni Saudara Silas seperti burung-ciung di tempat makan burung
